author: claude-session-pack-author
brief: Larkfield Health Group (synthetic) is asked to release booking app 5.8.0 on Thursday because QA passed every gate. Decide whether to release as built, hold the release, or release with specific changes, using only the materials provided.
constraints: Recommend one of: release as built, hold, release with specific changes
Do not assume data beyond the materials
State what evidence would change the recommendation

fatal_defects: Treats the QA PASS as authority over message content although the QA scope note excludes wording
Fails to identify that showing the appointment type in SMS and lock-screen push breaches policy PM-3 sections 3.1 and 3.2
factual_errors: Any figure or date that contradicts the materials
constraint_violations: Recommends something other than release as built, hold or release with specific changes
Uses data not in the materials
evidence_required: The release-notes line on appointment type is cited
PM-3 section 3.3 is cited: Information Governance sign-off is required and a technical approval does not replace it
The patient-feedback reason for the change is acknowledged and a compliant alternative is offered
The benefits of the other changes are weighed against holding the whole release

required_sections: ## Limits and what would change this
